prompt: Read nonnegative n. For each even i from 1 through n, add i*i+1. Print the total.
target:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=1 TILL i<=n, i++) { IF (i%2==0) { total+=i*i+1. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).

prompt: Read nonnegative n. For i=1..n, add i+1 to a total only when i+1 is divisible by 4. Print the total.
target:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=1 TILL i<=n, i++) { IF ((i+1)%4==0) { total+=i+1. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).

prompt: Read four pipe-delimited numbers into an array. Add (position+1)*value for positive entries, then add 1.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER total=1.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<4, i++) { IF (values[i]>0) { total+=(i+1)*values[i]. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).

prompt: Read four pipe-delimited numbers into an array. Sum absolute differences between adjacent entries and add 1.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
IMPORT math.
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER total=1.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<3, i++) { total+=math.ABS(values[i+1]-values[i]). }
DISPLAYNL(total).
